Data from the official YouTube API. Synthetic voice narration. #Top10RS #shorts

escenas.texto: Which was the most liked video in Africa this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, Can You Fight With A Sword In Your Mouth? 🤔, by Zack D. Films, with over 234 thousand likes.
In second place, Ranking Funniest Waterslide Moments, by SunsetCroc, with over 255 thousand likes.
And number one: How a Snowdrift Becomes An Igloo, by From The Ground Up, with over 506 thousand likes.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
